recommendation.now: Keep current single-owner SQLite+flock+Git CAS boundary for E16; current exact LocalGitCycleSandbox type gate still means no production deployment adapter. Scheduling alone does not justify runtime replacement.
recommendation.first_comparison: DBOS+SQLite is first genuinely new candidate to compare in an isolated offline failure harness, pinned audited e63ee714e031287c9b3447a173be835d6eaf1f95, with no install or infra introduced by this research. Compare existing kernel against multi-stage recovery and durable waits, not only cadence.
recommendation.strongest_counterargument: DBOS already supplies maintained recovery, queueing and durable sleeps; continuing to grow custom recovery logic can cost more and be less reliable than a library. The existing cadence commits slot before work and is not a general resumable workflow. Do not reject DBOS merely because current code exists.
recommendation.switching_trigger: When an actual E16 workload needs multi-step resume/long waits and custom state/recovery code grows beyond cadence/journal fences, use the offline matrix to compare recovery completeness, authority preservation, operational footprint and cost; select DBOS if it removes that code without weakening no-double-send/readback. For true multi-host ownership, SQLite runtime alone fails and Postgres/shared authority fence must be proven first.
recommendation.avoid_false_novelty: Railway remains an already-studied host option, not a newly discovered durable engine.

patch_proposals.proposal: Extract one helper that performs fresh journal lookup, pure admission, reserve and immediate guarded send under existing owner_lock. It returns serializable key/status/receipt, never replayable dispatch=True permission. Retain exact sandbox host type guard. Do not decorate host.send alone with retry.
patch_proposals.interface: dispatch_owned_once(state_store, host, packet, now) -> dict[str, object]
patch_proposals.why: All inspected runtimes execute action before recording result; cached reserve.dispatch=True in a separate checkpoint can authorize duplicate sends.

patch_proposals.proposal: Expose bounded immutable stored pending records, preserving packet_json/expected_parent binding and dispatch=False on existing rows. Do not convert state to an engine idempotency TTL. Support startup recovery of pending keys before accepting new scheduled candidates.

Resume from stored key+original packet+original expected_parent through read-only exact occurrence lookup. Retry reads with bounded backoff; UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; a later observation must be new read execution rather than cached UNKNOWN. Before rollback require target still equals exact candidate; moved target stays superseded/UNKNOWN instead of restoring stale bytes.
patch_proposals.boundary: Only reconcile_owned validates occurrence and closes journal PRESENT; engine success/cached output never does.

patch_proposals.proposal: Extend existing real Git offline fixture for runtime-neutral restart boundaries and use same assertions for optional DBOS experiment.
assertions: Crash after reservation before send: retry/resume send count 0, UNKNOWN remains; no liveness guessed.
Remote commit then lost reply or lost engine result: exactly 1 target advance and total send count <=1; restart reconciles original receipt, later replay writes0.
Cached reserve.dispatch=True must not be reusable send permission; helper rechecks journal and refuses second dispatch.
Engine dedup expires after >24h: retained journal key still blocks duplicate and reconciles original occurrence.
Restore backup after reservation, commit happened after backup: restored pending record reconciles exact original SHA/parent/bodies, no send.

Restore backup from before reservation: missing journal is not proof of absence; do not reconstruct expected_parent from current target. Block dispatch until original binding/authoritative recovery; Git CAS still prevents stale expected-parent target advance.
Wrong occurrence/parent or missing source evidence never produces PRESENT; UNKNOWN writes remains null.
Second owner blocked and target moved after old worker starts cannot be advanced by old expected_parent CAS.
Keep tests/test_owned_digital_cycle.py authority/scope guards and test_host_required_not_ci_deployed unchanged.
